lines: Mitchell's role has grown lately: he played 79% of snaps over his last three games, up from 72% on the season, and saw 8.0 targets per game.
He's averaging 12.0 PPR points and 67.0 receiving yards per game over that stretch, on 3.3 catches. He has just 1 touchdown this season.
Week 11 is at the Chargers, who allow the 6th-most PPR points per game to WRs, though the Jets are only implied for 18.5 points.
